method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (cpp-core.l4, with six regulative rules) and a seat layer (cpp-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a year or death before 2019, and a survivor with their own retirement pension, answer not covered, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Canada Pension Plan, R.S.C., 1985, c. C-8, and Canada Pension Plan Regulations, C.R.C., c. 385, Justice Laws consolidation current to 2026-09-30 (Act last amended 2024-12-17; Regulations 2026-01-01), from justicecanada/laws-lois-xml commit 0507465393c224c0491fc8c17c88340217acc656, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/R.S.C.-1985-c.-C-8.txt and C.R.C.-c.-385.txt. Rates from Schedules 1 and 2; YAMPE computed under s 18.1; the YMPE, indexed flat rates and earnings-record figures are inputs.

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run cpp-core.l4 ; l4 run cpp-seat.l4 ; l4 run cpp-cases-contributor.l4
checks.result: 73 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 3 #TRACEs with an expect line (2 breaches by the contributor, 1 obligation of the Minister pending), each read and as expected
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the contributor and the survivor: Part I ss 8(1)-(1.2), 10(1)-(1.2), 11.1(2), 11.2, Schedules 1-2, ss 12(1)(d), 16, 17(a), 17.1(a), 18.1, 19(a), 20(2) (employee and self-employed contributions from 2019, one employer, no provincial plan); Part II s 2 contributor, s 42(1)-(2), s 44(1)(a)-(d), (2)(a), (3), ss 44.1(1)(a), 44.2, s 46(1), (3.1) with Regulations ss 78.3-78.4, s 48(4), s 56(1), (3)-(4), s 57(1)(b), (1.2), s 58(1)(a.1), (b), s 67(3.1), s 69; duties under s 30(1), s 66(1), s 81, Regulations ss 46.2, 70.1, 71(2) as regulative rules. Out: employer contributions and duties, provincial plans, post-65 elections, computing AMPE from a record, divisions and sharing, s 58(2) and (6), post-retirement benefits, children's benefits, indexation, pre-2019 rules, recovery and offences. Read with subjects/ca/income-tax-act/ (contributory salary and wages, self-employed earnings, filing date, credits and deductions); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seat: the individual: the contributor (employee or self-employed), the contributor claiming a retirement or disability pension, and the survivor of a contributor
